messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: sustained RPM spike detected for model family "orca-lite" in us-west-2. 5xx rate up ~1.8% above baseline — auto-shaping triggered (reduced RPM). Escalating to oncall.

mike (oncall): on it, joining the thread. any immediate customer impact? :eyes:

samantha (eng-runtime): grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/ork?panel=5 shows queue depth + p95 latency rising over the last 6m. some backpressure on the routing tier. suggests temporary RPM cap to 600 for orca-lite v1 family and disable funcall to reduce per-request cost.

raj (eng-sre): confirming infra: serving nodes for orca-lite are at ~92% GPU mem and 87% compute. KV cache churn is high. we have a lower-memory variant (orca-lite-quant) available for fallback routing. recommend: 1) lower RPM, 2) lower TPM if needed, 3) enable fallback routing to quantized variant.

mike (oncall): ok applying mitigation now. executing quota update:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/ops/quota \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -d '{"model_family":"orca-lite","rpm":600,"tpm":10000}'
```
will also disable funcall for that family while we stabilize.

infra-bot: Webhook: quota update accepted. change queued, effective in ~30s. payload id: q_8f3a. New target: RPM=600, TPM=10000 for family=orca-lite.

mike (oncall): disabling function-calling on orca-lite: `rbctl feature-disable --family orca-lite --feature funcall` — sent.

infra-bot: Feature toggle updated: funcall disabled for family=orca-lite. Routing rules recompiled, rollout ~45s.

samantha (eng-runtime): quick check after changes: p95 latency trending down, error rate now 0.9% (was 1.8%). queue depth reduced. looks stable but will watch for 15m.

lucy (cust-succ): FYI patched top affected customer PaperTrail — they reported ~20% failed requests earlier. They confirm fewer failures after the quota change. I'll open a support note and schedule a follow-up with them tomorrow.

mike (oncall): handing off to @tara for the overnight watch. summary: quota set -> RPM 600, TPM 10k; funcall disabled; fallback routing enabled to orca-lite-quant if capacity tight. see runbook bullets in #oncall-runbooks.

tara (oncall-next): taking over. I'll monitor dashboards and alerting, and escalate if we see >1% 5xx or repeat spikes. consider per-tenant carveouts if a single customer causes sustained pressure. :thumbsup:

mike (oncall): logging: incident ticket INC-2023-824 created and linked; added commands, snapshots, and timeline. tagging for postmortem: eng-runtime, eng-sre, cust-succ. closing this thread — reopen if regression observed.
